title: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan's birth chart
metaDescription: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.8° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 1.0° separates Mercury and Saturn from an exact sextile; at that range thinking and structure read as one mechanism. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 19.8° Libra — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that Saturn, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 3.6° Scorpio, Venus was at 7.7° Virgo, Mars was at 27.2° Scorpio. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that grows by reliability; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mercury and Saturn — a sextile holding at 1.0°. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, Saturn sextile Uranus at 2.1°, and Mercury trine Uranus at 3.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. The Sun in Libra at 19.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Virgo at 7.7° is in fall; Mars in Scorpio at 27.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 23.9° is in domicile. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 3, air 2, earth 2, fire 2; modalities cardinal 3, fixed 3, mutable 3. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. Mercury and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aquarius into Pisces during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.9° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
